purpose: Teach: 短縮/共存/退院/各自/待機/早起き/仲介/専業

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究時間、本気で、絶対、短縮、絶対、せず、絶対、深めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — don't shorten your research time. Deepen it. That's what I'm asking.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Steady eye contact. Weight behind each phrase without raising volume. The tone of someone who has seen what happens when researchers rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。理論と実験、本気で、絶対、共存、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm working to balance theory and experiment, and I'm grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not overly formal—a student who trusts the instruction he's received. Quiet conviction underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 入院した先輩の、本気で、絶対、退院、絶対、お祝い、絶対、行ってこい、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Go visit your senior when he leaves the hospital. Celebrate with him. That matters.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. A clear directive wrapped in something warmer—the voice of a mentor who knows what researchers need beyond the lab.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究者、本気で、絶対、各自、絶対、分担、絶対、明確にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've made sure my collaborators and I have clear divisions of labour. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Steady, precise. The careful response of someone taking the instruction seriously. Slight pause before 'thank you'—genuine, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発表前、本気で、絶対、待機、絶対、するように、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Before your presentation, don't waver. Hold steady. That's the task.
lines.style: Clipped, intentional phrasing. Each sentence lands. The voice of someone who knows the moment before a presentation is when resolve matters most.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文執筆、本気で、絶対、早起き、絶対、習慣、絶対、続けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've kept the early morning writing habit going, and I'm grateful for your faith in me.
lines.style: Determined but humble. A rhythm that shows he's thought about this. Trails slightly on the last phrase—acknowledging both the work done and the trust placed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同研究、本気で、絶対、仲介、絶対、教授、絶対、依頼しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'll ask the professor to mediate the collaborative research. I'll get it done.
lines.style: Decisive. No hedging. The voice of someone who has heard an instruction and will execute it. Slight firmness on the commitment at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者、本気で、絶対、専業、絶対、目指して、絶対、おります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm aiming to become a researcher full-time, and I'm grateful for everything you've shown me.
lines.style: Quiet determination underscored by real gratitude. Slower pace. The closing of a conversation where a student has understood what was asked of him and what he's becoming.
